Hi Samir / Ruth —

Thanks again for taking the time to run through Redwood yesterday. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce LLM inference unit costs for customer-facing chat by ~40% while maintaining latency SLAs.
- Current pain: fragmented endpoints, unpredictable tail latency on peak, and manual model rollouts.
- Compliance: Hydra needs SOC 2 + audit logs retained for 1 year.

What Redwood can help with (high level)
- Unified serving runtime with predictable per-token economics and fallbacks.
- Dedicated capacity option for production workloads and Private deployment for regulated data.
- Observability + evals to detect regressions during model changes.

Proposed next steps
1) Mutual Action Plan (attached): I put estimated timelines and owners — please review and flag anything inaccurate.
2) Technical deep-dive: schedule a 60-min session with your infra lead and our solutions engineer (Aditya).
3) Pricing sketch: I included a baseline estimate in the MAP; we can refine based on the final traffic profile.

Can you let me know which day next week works for the technical deep-dive? I pasted a Calendly link in the MAP and attached the demo recording + MAP for easy reference.
